name: Australian National Maritime Museum concession tickets and membership
summary: Concession See it all tickets and a cheaper concession annual membership for full-time students at the Maritime Museum, Darling Harbour.
key: Concession annual membership is $85 for full-time students; See it all concession tickets are $30 (adult $35).
who: Full-time students (also adults over 60, pensioners and the unemployed).
catches: The page does not spell out who qualifies for the $30 See it all concession ticket.

evidence.quote: Concession (full time student or adult over 60 or pensioner or unemployed): $85.00
